title: NetApi NetUseAdd auth identity length gate

contains.const: UseAdd validates every NETAPI_USE_ADD_REQ wire field before PipeServer::ImpersonateCaller or NetUseAdd can run

contracts: UseAdd validates every NETAPI_USE_ADD_REQ wire field before PipeServer::ImpersonateCaller or NetUseAdd can run
ui4_auth_identity_length uses the NETAPI_USE_ADD_REQ fixed 2048 byte wire buffer limit
ui4_auth_identity_length equal to ULONG -1 remains the null auth identity sentinel
ui4_auth_identity_length greater than 2048 sets ERROR_INVALID_PARAMETER and exits before impersonation
valid ui4_auth_identity bytes are locally terminated before USE_INFO_4 points at the wire buffer
parm_index based string length failures still return ERROR_INVALID_PARAMETER before impersonation
NetUseAdd receives only a USE_INFO shaped buffer assembled from validated local wire fields
LaunchSlave still runs only after NetUseAdd succeeds
NetUseAdd level policy local string limits password handling and drive notification topology are unchanged
runtime_gates: NetUseAdd positive smoke for a valid local drive mapping request
malformed MSGID_NETAPI_USE_ADD request with level 4 and ui4_auth_identity_length 2049 proving ERROR_INVALID_PARAMETER without NetUseAdd call
sentinel request with ui4_auth_identity_length ULONG -1 proving null auth identity behavior remains unchanged
valid 2048 byte auth identity request proving termination and NetUseAdd forwarding behavior remain unchanged
